descripcion: Open Add («Añadir») and place a lantern in the plaza.

pasos.texto: Open Add («Añadir») and drag a Lantern («Farolillo») into the plaza

textos.aceptada: The Add drawer holds the library: drag «Farolillo» (Lantern) onto the ground.
textos.completada: That is how you place an object: from the library into the world.
